svg.aria-label: UIUCTF 2026 Binary Exploitation writeup cover — both pwn challenges solved. Firefly: Complete Combustion is a Lua 5.5.0 bytecode-only sandbox where the stock luai_verifycode hook is empty, so a valid luac output is patched to run three OP_FORLOOP instructions whose chgivalue mutates payload but preserves tag, giving payload-arithmetic type confusion; a fake TString gives arbitrary read, a fake Table gives arbitrary write, print is retargeted to hidden luaB_loadfile at delta 0xbb0, fclose@GOT is redirected to fflush under partial RELRO to keep /flag.txt's stdio buffer alive, and string.match uiuctf%b{} extracts the flag. Sparxie: Vanishing Encore is a WebAssembly moderation client where the archive Spotlight Pass BLAKE2s seal covers header[8:16] and body[0:28] but not the 16-byte route field, so the archive pass converts to a relay permit with a forged route; two distinct clips at (0, 4096) collapse into one relocation record so one clip is left over the freed studio page that the queue immediately reuses, all 63 queue slot pointers are rewritten to the static draft-object pool at 0x1f720, a Lua-implemented BLAKE2s reproduces the SPARXIE::ENCORE::PROOF witness, and draft:publish() calls sparxie_redeem to print the flag
